items.title: SENSITIVITY
items.quote: Praises to the giver of understanding care to the invalid.
items.text: When you care for an invalid, you should be sensitive to his needs. This is a great mitzvah.

items.quote: On the day of evil, [console the patient by telling him that surely] Hashem will save him.

items.title: CONCERN
items.quote: [Pray] that Hashem will protect [the patient] and give him life.
items.text: Show your concern for an invalid and help him by praying to Hashem for his recovery.

items.w: יהוה חנני רפאה נפשי כי חטאתי לך
items.title: HEALING
items.quote: Hashem, have pity on me! Heal my soul for I have sinned against You!
items.text: When you ask Hashem to heal your illness, acknowledge your sins against Him. In that way you will demonstrate that the purpose of your suffering has been served and the time has come for healing.

items.w: ברוך יהוה אלהי ישראל מהעולם ועד העולם אמן ואמן
items.title: BLESSED
items.quote: Blessed is Hashem, the G-d of Yisrael from [the beginning of] the World to the [Next] World, Amen and Amen.
items.text: May Hashem’s blessings of kindness continue to flow throughout space and time.
